notes: Experimental plus GCMC paper (title: combined experimental and simulation study). The samples are jujube-branch activated carbons (N-AC900-2, N-AC900-1, N-AC800-1, AC900, AC800), carbon 81.9-88.4 % by mass (Table 1), with own H2 isotherms at -196 and 25 °C up to 1 bar (Fig. 9). The article does not use the words volumetric or Sieverts for the H2 measurement; I1 is judged met because H2 uptake from the gas phase is measured on a Micromeritics ASAP2020 Plus sorption analyzer, an instrument type that is volumetric. SBET stated for the same five samples used in the H2 measurements. Table 1 labels the first five rows 'The present work' and no statement says these H2 values were published before (no duplicate_data). is_retracted is false in record.json and no retraction notice appears in the PDF text. Not a review or abstract-only document. No electrochemical hydrogen storage. Supplementary file (si1) holds only GCMC force-field parameters and simulated density/heat plots, with no further experimental data. Article is in English.
